item.title: Lindsay Gang — Sat Jul 25, 12:30 PM — Hopmonk Tavern
item.description:
Singer-songwriter, Lindsay Gang, was born and raised in Northern California. The traveling songbird’s experiences have taken her from the West Coast to the Midwest, the East Coast, and back. She makes sense of the ebb and flow of life by turning her experiences and travels into song. She self-released her first two EPs, Array of Color and Hanging On, in 2022. With warm vocals, lush guitar, and tender, heartfelt lyrics, her songs possess the quality of exceptional fidelity; they are reflective, intimate, and raw – echoing indie folk with a dreamy Americana feel.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Sonoma Valley Events

item.title: My Dog Jack — Sat Jul 25, 1:00 PM — Sebastopolathon Music Fest
item.description:
My Dog Jack is one of San Francisco's rising Americana/folk bands. After playing live for years as part of various folk, jazz, and bluegrass groups around the Bay Area, the fellas joined forces last year to return to their songwriting roots. Inspired by legends like John Prine, The Band, and Kate Wolf, as well as contemporary artists such as Hurray for the Riff Raff, The Wood Brothers, and The Devil Makes Three, My Dog Jack brings a cold coast-influenced take on western music.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: The Cemetery Club — Fri Jul 31, 8:00 PM — Bay Area Stage Theatre on Broadway
item.description:
Don’t be fooled by the title of this play – it’s a comedy!
Ivan Menchell’s The Cemetery Club is a bittersweet comedy about three Jewish widows in Queens, New York, who meet monthly to visit their husbands' graves. Their routine is upended when one of them begins dating a widower, who, they incidentally, meet at the cemetery. The ensuing drama tests their loyalties, offering a poignant look at love, friendship and moving on.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

Let's keep together as much as we can during these uncertain times and keep on writing. Look for the schedule online and join us.
We’ve discovered that it’s strikingly helpful to write with other writers. See if it’s true for you at 3pm on Friday afternoon. item.title: The Cemetery Club — Sat Aug 8, 8:00 PM — Bay Area Stage Theatre on Broadway
item.description:
Don’t be fooled by the title of this play – it’s a comedy!
Ivan Menchell’s The Cemetery Club is a bittersweet comedy about three Jewish widows in Queens, New York, who meet monthly to visit their husbands' graves. Their routine is upended when one of them begins dating a widower, who, they incidentally, meet at the cemetery. The ensuing drama tests their loyalties, offering a poignant look at love, friendship and moving on.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
